combo_label: At the Seaside × Fireworks & Bonfire Night × Vikings

entries.clue: A miser heaps one up; ploughs still turn up Viking ones
Last live coal still glowing in the grey ash at midnight
Ship's right-hand side, named for the steering oar Norse helmsmen hung there
Round wooden disc with an iron boss, locked rim-to-rim into a living wall
Seawater basin among the boulders where children hunt crabs with a net.
Grey flakes left on the ground next morning, still warm underfoot
Arctic sea-beast's great tooth, the northern colonies' costliest export
Sudden leap of flame, or a signal light fired from a boat
Cook in dry heat, as chestnuts are done in a pan on the coals
Shuttered wooden cabin on the front, its hatch flapped up to sell ices
Concrete rampart holding the winter breakers off the houses on the front
Orange bloom eating the seafront railings where the salt spray settles
